device_judgment_revision.boundary: These are separate contemporaneous Judgment vintages. Mobile-phone and smartphone terminology is preserved rather than silently normalized, and later revisions do not overwrite earlier replay state.

pc_outcome_candidate.boundary: Outcome comparison is same-publisher/same-market-scope and preliminary. Do not treat the preliminary sell-in estimate as a final immutable statistic.

lead_dispositions.researcher_interpretation: Server-platform transitions should be represented as a staged trajectory: platform enablement, memory qualification, module shipment/deployment and later demand observations remain separate states.
lead_dispositions.canonical_boundary: Do not use CPU launch or protocol support as the onset date of memory demand.

lead_dispositions.researcher_interpretation: Device demand analysis can preserve the year-in-progress revision of unit forecasts before comparing the PC series with a later same-publisher preliminary Outcome, while per-device memory-content expectations remain separate.
lead_dispositions.canonical_boundary: Do not multiply forecast units by forecast content into realized memory bits; smartphone full-year same-scope Outcome remains open.

research_compositions.summary: Platform enablement → memory qualification → module shipment/deployment → installed-base/bit-demand observation is a useful researcher ladder, but individual rungs are not deterministic substitutes for later rungs.
The 2024 Gartner PC/phone outlook was revised downward during the year; preserving each vintage exposes contemporaneous cognition rather than only hindsight forecast error.

Gartner's preliminary 1.3% 2024 PC growth estimate is 2.2 percentage points below its February 3.5% forecast and 1.1 points below its March/May 2.4% forecasts; this arithmetic does not itself create an Outcome relation until CAP-0004 projection is executed.
